targets.rawSql: select * from xproxy_tester.rotation_cycles where $__timeFilter(cycle_timestamp) and cycle_type = 'periodic'

SELECT
  r.proxy_id                                                    AS proxy_id,
  p.name                                                        AS device_name,
  CASE
    WHEN p.name REGEXP '^[S|s]+[0-9]+.*[P|p][0-9]+.*$'
    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.name, 'P', 1)
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END                                                           AS server_name,
  p.location                                                    AS location,
  p.country                                                     AS country,
  p.city                                                        AS city,
  r.rotation_type                                               AS rotation_type,

  COUNT(*)                                                      AS attempts,
  SUM(r.success = 1)                                            AS rotated_count,
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN r.success = 0
         AND r.error_message IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END)                                                      AS failed_count,
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN r.success = 0
         AND r.ip_before IS NOT NULL
         AND r.ip_after  IS NOT NULL
         AND r.ip_before = r.ip_after THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END)                                                      AS no_change_count,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(r.success = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2)      AS success_rate_pct,

  MIN(r.rotation_timestamp)                                     AS first_attempt,
  MAX(r.rotation_timestamp)                                     AS last_attempt,

  COUNT(DISTINCT r.ip_after)                                    AS distinct_ips_seen,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rotation_duration_ms))                            AS avg_rotation_duration_ms,
  ROUND(AVG(r.wait_time_ms))                                    AS avg_wait_time_ms,

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.ip_after ORDER BY r.ip_after SEPARATOR '|') AS distinct_ips,

  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN r.success = 1
         THEN DATE_FORMAT(r.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
    END
    ORDER BY r.rotation_timestamp SEPARATOR '|'
  ) AS rotated_at_timestamps,

  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN r.success = 0 AND r.error_message IS NOT NULL
         THEN DATE_FORMAT(r.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
    END
    ORDER BY r.rotation_timestamp SEPARATOR '|'
  )                                                             AS failed_at_timestamps,

  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN r.success = 0
              AND r.ip_before IS NOT NULL
              AND r.ip_after = r.ip_before
         THEN DATE_FORMAT(r.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')
    END
    ORDER BY r.rotation_timestamp SEPARATOR '|'
  )                                                             AS no_change_at_timestamps,

  GROUP_CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN r.success = 1
         THEN CONCAT(COALESCE(r.ip_before,'?'), '>', COALESCE(r.ip_after,'?'))
    END
    ORDER BY r.rotation_timestamp SEPARATOR '|'
  )                                                             AS ip_transitions,

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.error_message SEPARATOR ' || ')       AS distinct_errors

FROM ip_rotations r
LEFT JOIN proxies p ON p.device_id = r.proxy_id
WHERE r.rotation_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 15 DAY
  AND r.ws_status_before = 'connected'
GROUP BY
  r.proxy_id,
  p.name,
  CASE
    WHEN p.name REGEXP '^[S|s]+[0-9]+.*[P|p][0-9]+.*$'
    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.name, 'P', 1)
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END,
  p.location,
  p.country,
  p.city,
  r.rotation_type
ORDER BY
  server_name,
  r.proxy_id,
  r.rotation_type;

SELECT
  p.name AS device_name,
  CASE
    WHEN p.name REGEXP '^[s|S]+[0-9]+[P|p][0-9]+$'
    THEN SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.name, 'P', 1)
    ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
  END AS server_name
FROM proxies p
ORDER BY server_name, device_name
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    *
FROM
    ip_rotations
WHERE
    proxy_id = '0a69731833f27210'
        AND rotation_timestamp >= '2026-04-22'
        AND ip_before IS NOT NULL;
